summary_1line: After Yudhishthira’s grand sacrifice, a half‑golden mongoose declares it inferior to a starving Brahmana family's selfless gift of barley to a guest.

image_candidates.scene_text: A blue‑eyed mongoose with half its body turned to gold stands amid the crowded sacrificial arena, speaking as astonished Brahmanas look on.
Inside a humble hut during famine, a starving Brahmana family offers their tiny portions of powdered barley to a weary guest.
The divine guest reveals himself as the deity of Righteousness while celestial flowers rain from the sky upon the poor Brahmana.
